DETAIL: [CARDINALITY] TRF-120-ShipShape nltl:thrusterNaturalFrequency property: The shape restricts thrusterNaturalFrequency to at most one ship-level quantity, although the requirement concerns natural-frequency estimates in both longitudinal and transverse directions. The candidate provides no way to represent or distinguish the two directional frequency results. Required change: Remove the single-value restriction and require distinct natural-frequency results for the longitudinal and transverse calculation cases, with each result associated with its corresponding direction.
